title: Tensor ideal identifications compatible with inclusion
statement: For a scheme X and nested ideal sheaf data J ≤ I, tensor sections of I and J are isomorphic to the kernels of additive restriction to their closed subschemes. The tensor inclusion composed with the first identification and its kernel inclusion equals the second identification composed with its kernel inclusion.

proof.text: For each ideal use the sectionwise canonical limiting kernel fork. Evaluations jointly reflect presheaf limits, so this gives a presheaf kernel fork.

Apply left-exact sheafification and use the invertible counits on the structure sheaf and its closed-subscheme lower direct image. Counit naturality and cancellation of the target counit identify the zero-composite conditions. KernelFork.isLimitOfIsLimitOfIff transports the limiting fork to the specified restriction map. Uniqueness of limiting cones constructs its kernel isomorphism with the required inclusion equation.

Construct these kernel isomorphisms for I and J. Rewrite their composites with kernel inclusion as the sheafified ideal-section inclusions followed by the common counit. Functoriality and whiskerRight_comp reduce compatibility to IdealSheafData.toModulesOfLE_toModulesι, the already proved equality of the original nested ideal inclusions.

proof_origin.place: Proof, Step 1 and its Claim; N1 sectionwise-kernel proof followed by left-exact sheafification, counit transport and functorial inclusion compatibility.

theorem exists_etaleIdealKernelIsoPair (X : Scheme.{u})
    (I J : X.IdealSheafData) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    ∃ eI : (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsFunctor X).obj I.toModules ≅
        kernel (etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar I.subschemeι),
      ∃ eJ : (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsFunctor X).obj J.toModules ≅
          kernel (etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar J.subschemeι),
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsFunctor X).map (IdealSheafData.toModulesOfLE hJI) ≫
            eI.hom ≫ kernel.ι (etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar I.subschemeι) =
          eJ.hom ≫ kernel.ι (etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar J.subschemeι)
